title: Efficacy, Safety and Pharmacokinetics of QAV680 Versus Placebo in Patients With Asthma
brief_summary: This study will assess the safety and efficacy of QAV680 in patients with mild to moderate asthma
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with moderate persistent asthma

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smokers
* Any significant disease or illness, other than asthma

Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply
